cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-blockquote.p: добросердечность (ж.) – (noun) качество человеческой души, проявляющееся в заботе и отзывчивости.

p.em: Example: Якоб сохраняет добросердечность вопреки жестоким испытаниям.

cosy-blockquote.p: преодоление заклятий (ср.) – (noun) борьба с колдовством и восстановление своего настоящего облика.

p.em: Example: Преодоление заклятий требует от героев верности и ума.

cosy-blockquote.p: внутренняя красота (ж.) – (noun) душевные качества и доброта, скрытые за непривлекательной внешностью.

p.em: Example: Принцесса Грета распознает внутреннюю красоту Карлика Носа.

cosy-blockquote.p: верность (ж.) ≠ предательство (ср.) – (noun) преданность друзьям в противоположность коварному измену.

p.em: Example: Верность Якоба и Греты помогает им разрушить чары злодейки.

cosy-blockquote.p: ведьмино проклятие (ср.) – (noun) злое колдовство, превратившее мальчика в горбатого карлика.

p.em: Example: Ведьмино проклятие лишает Якоба семьи на долгие годы.

cosy-blockquote.p: проклятие (ср.) – (noun) заклинание, приносящее несчастье или трансформацию человека.

p.em: Example: Злая колдунья налагает проклятие на юного Якоба.

cosy-blockquote.p: колдовство (ср.) – (noun) применение темных волшебных сил и зелий.

p.em: Example: Колдовство старухи заставляет Якоба служить в её замке.

cosy-blockquote.p: доброта (ж.) – (noun) душевное расположение к людям и стремление делать добро.

p.em: Example: Доброта героя помогает ему подружиться с заколдованной гусыней.

cosy-blockquote.p: превращение (ср.) – (noun) изменение внешнего вида или формы человека под действием магии.

p.em: Example: Чудесное превращение возвращает Якобу его прежний облик.

cosy-blockquote.p: чудо-зелье (ср.) – (noun) волшебный отвар или трава, снимающая чары.

p.em: Example: Особая трава 'чихотка' служит как чудо-зелье против проклятия.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: В парах или малых группах обсудите следующие вопросы:

ol.li:
How does the opening of 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' show the idea of kindheartedness? Practice with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you were in 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)', how would you handle the challenges of kindheartedness?

How does the director introduce overcoming curses early in the movie? Focus on contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Have you ever faced a problem where you had to deal with overcoming curses?

As the story goes on, does inner beauty create problems for Jacob (the dwarf Nose)? Frame your answer with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Does the way the movie shows inner beauty feel like real life to you?

How do the scenes in 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' show loyalty between the main characters? Use contextual Conversational Structures.
★ How do you personally keep loyalty in balance in your life?

How does Jacob (the dwarf Nose) react to the challenge of ведьмино проклятие? Discuss using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you could change one decision made by Jacob (the dwarf Nose) about ведьмино проклятие, what would it be?

What clues and secrets about 'проклятие' can you find in the movie? Use contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Have you ever used a word or expression like 'проклятие' in your own life?

How does the script use the expression 'колдовство' to make the scene more interesting? Respond with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Do you think learning casual words like 'колдовство' is helpful for fluency?

How does using 'доброта' show the characters' real feelings during overcoming a witch's curse, discovering inner beauty, and proving loyalty? Formulate with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Is there an equivalent word in your language for 'доброта'?

How does learning the truth about 'превращение' change what you think of the characters? Analyze with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ When you want to express a feeling, do you use slang or direct words like 'превращение'?

If they knew the truth about 'чудо-зелье' earlier, how would the story change? Speculate using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ What is your favorite line of dialogue from the movie 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)'?

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: В парах выразите свое согласие или несогласие с утверждениями:

ol.li:
'Jacob (the dwarf Nose)'s story of kindheartedness in 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' is very sad, and they should be more careful.' Do you agree? Use contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you were a director, how would you show the concept of kindheartedness?

'Jacob (the dwarf Nose)'s movie makes the world look too beautiful, but it has a high cost.' Discuss using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Do you think the visuals of a movie are more powerful than the dialogue?

'Jacob (the dwarf Nose) is not a nice person because they only care about inner beauty.' Give your opinion using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Have you ever felt that a movie's alternative ending would be better?

'Jacob (the dwarf Nose)'s movie 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' is too simple and does not show deep feelings about loyalty.' Talk about this with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you could choose a song from your life to match the theme of loyalty, what would it be?

'Jacob (the dwarf Nose)'s problem of overcoming a witch's curse, discovering inner beauty, and proving loyalty never ends because they cannot agree on ведьмино проклятие.' Explain using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ What was the most memorable scene in 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' that made you think?

'The film would be better if the director chose a different setting for 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)'.' Speculate using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Would you ever want to write a story based on your own life experiences?

'The secondary characters, like the evil witch, the goose Mimi, and his family, are more interesting than the main hero.' Evaluate with contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Which part of filmmaking (music, camera angles, lighting) has the biggest effect on you?

'The music and sound design are what make 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' a great movie.' Discuss using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you could change the cast of 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)', which actors would you choose?

'The recurring visual symbols are important to understand the film's deeper meaning.' Discuss using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ Do you enjoy analyzing movies or do you prefer to just watch the story?

'The story of 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)' is a critique of real-world human behavior.' Discuss using contextual Conversational Structures.
★ If you could save only one scene from 'Karlik Nos (Dwarf Nose)', which one would it be?
